recommended_action: Remove or mark NON-CORE with a note that the evidence is high-throughput Y2H on an ORF construct from a pseudogene locus
rationale: Six IPI annotations from two systematic yeast two-hybrid screens. The assay expresses a cloned ORF as a fusion in yeast and cannot establish that an endogenous LPAL2 polypeptide exists. Partner set (VAC14 HIP1 CLSTN1-2 CCK CASP6 RAN) has no coherent biology for a secreted kringle protein. GO advice also discourages protein binding as a final informative annotation.

Projected from the predicted signal peptide at residues 1 to 21 of a conceptual translation whose reading frame is destroyed in vivo by a splice donor loss (PMID:7749817) and by a premature TAG at codon 223 shared with chimpanzee bonobo and gorilla. A localisation term for a protein that is not made is not supportable.

recommended_action: Do not add a function term; record the locus as a transcribed pseudogene
rationale: Nonsynonymous divergence across the ORF region matches the local neutral rate (obs/exp 0.91 to 1.13). No molecular function process or location can be assigned to a product that evolutionary and annotation evidence say is not translated.

recommended_action: Lead: ask UniProt to re-examine the keyword
rationale: ProteomicsDB holds zero MS records for Q16609 while apo(a) plasminogen albumin and haemoglobin beta return 44 to 79 tissues in the identical query, and no PeptideAtlas cross-reference is present. A curator should check whether the MassIVE jPOST and ProteomicsDB cross-references rest on any peptide that discriminates Q16609 from apo(a) or plasminogen
